title: LE (Linear Executable) signature (OS/2, Windows VxD)
summary: LE (Linear Executable) is a 32-bit executable format used by OS/2 2.x and Windows VxDs. Magic: 'MZ' at offset 0, with 'LE' at e_lfanew offset.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: LE is the 32-bit predecessor of PE.
LE supports 32-bit flat addressing (vs NE's segmented model).
LE is used by OS/2 2.x and Windows 95/98 VxDs.
